title: A reference to an id a merge absorbed still reaches the record that survived
intent: Rows X1 and 9 of a.csv are proven to be one contact by their shared legacy id L1, so row 9 is absorbed into X1. The company in b.csv names the contact by the raw id 9. That id was the contact's before the merge and is the contact's after it: the relationship must resolve to the surviving contact, and it must not be reported as a source record that could not be found.
